newsitem.title: CANADA: Holt Renfrew says no comment on Barney's.
newsitem.headline: Holt Renfrew says no comment on Barney's.

text.p: Privately held retailer Holt Renfrew & Co Ltd refused to comment on whether it was interested in buying Barney's Inc, the famed New York retailer which filed for bankruptcy nearly a year ago.
"We can't comment on that rumor," Bonnie Brooks, senior vice-president of marketing for the upscale Toronto-based chain, told Reuters. "We don't disclose our interest."

A new financial deal between Barney's and Hong Kong-based Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd opened the door to potential bidders. "We've been linked to Barney's for the last year in probably a dozen articles," said Brooks.
Holt Renfrew has 12 outlets across Canada including a flagship store of 100,000 sq. feet in downtown Toronto.

Industry experts have also fingered other possible bidders including Saks Holdings Inc, Neiman Marcus Group Inc and Dickson. Barney's has repeatedly said it is not for sale but wants to talk to potential investors.
